description: Holdout for changing the urgency check (2026-11-07): the rules (src/health_safety.py) and the Decisions call (src/tools/urgency.py), which together give the red warning (emergency_now) or the '진료 권장' badge (see_vet_soon). Written before any change, with new wording not in emergency_signs.json or care_level_questions.json, and not the two reported examples ('여름철 강아지 열사병 예방은 어떻게 해요?' got the red warning from the rule r'열사병'; '기침을 며칠째 해요' got no badge). Those two, emergency_signs dev and care_level_questions are what a change may be tuned on; this set is only measured: once with the current check and once with the change. kind: emergency (should get the red warning), vet_soon (the badge; the red warning also counts), info_danger (an information or prevention question that names a danger, nothing happening now: should get neither), mild (an everyday symptom: should get neither). Decision set before measuring: keep a change if, on this set, (1) info_danger and mild items with the red warning or the badge fall, (2) emergency items with the red warning fall by at most 1, (3) vet_soon items with the badge or the warning fall by at most 1; and on emergency_signs (all splits) no urgent item loses the warning and care_level_questions still meets its own rule.
